verdict.rationale: Render connects to your existing Git repo and deploys on every push. Its Docker support lets you bring any framework, and community users praise both the Docker support and the out-of-the-box Elixir support. The REST API, CLI, webhooks and MCP integration with editors like Cursor and Claude Code let it fit into existing tooling rather than replace it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of integrating with external CI pipelines (e.g. deploy hooks or GitHub Actions), detailed framework-agnostic build docs, and clarity that the Render-specific render.yaml Blueprint format is optional rather than required.
